method.encounter: a passing test running a sampled mutant
method.kill_rate: a group's kills over its encounters
method.test_strength: mutants a group kills over the mutants it runs
method.shared_mutants: The mutants that tests of both groups run. A group's kill rate on a mutant is the share of its tests running the mutant that kill it, and the mean kill rates and their difference are over the shared mutants, each counted once whatever the size of the groups.
method.same_test_class: The shared mutants that tests of both groups in one test class run, which share that class's harness and fixtures. A group's kill rate on a mutant is the mean, over such test classes, of the share of the class's tests of the group running the mutant that kill it.
method.mean_difference_without: The pooled mean difference with each project left out in turn.
method.difference_interval: 95% percentile interval of the mean difference over 10000 resamples of whole mutated classes
method.test: class_sign_flip: the share of 10000 random sign flips of whole mutated classes' differences whose mean difference is at least as far from zero as the observed one, counting the observed one
method.correction: holm, over the tested comparisons of one set of tests; not over suites, nor over the pooled and per-project sets together
method.untested: A comparison whose mutants are of fewer than two classes has no interval or test, and one whose classes' differences are all zero has no test.
method.killed_only_by: Counts of shared mutants by which groups kill them; a group with more tests has more chances to kill.
